tools.name: usage
tools.description: Check how many Rams reviews this account has used and how many are left. Free to call. It does not use a review.

tools.name: review_files
tools.description: Full Rams design review of UI code (React, Vue, Svelte, HTML, CSS, SwiftUI). Returns a 0-100 score (criticals cap it: one caps at 59, two at 49, three or more at 39), issues with severity, category, file:line, and concrete fixes as patches. tools.name: quick_review
tools.description: Fast design and accessibility check of UI code (React, Vue, Svelte, HTML, CSS, SwiftUI). Returns the top issues with severity, category and file:line in about 10 seconds. Call it when the user pastes or uploads UI code, asks whether a design is good or accessible, or when you just wrote or changed a

tools.name: verify_fixes
tools.description: Re-check findings from an earlier Rams review against the updated code. Pass the new version of each file under the same path as before, plus the findings. Returns fixed or still present for each one. Free: it never counts against the user's quota. Use it after you fix the issues.

tools.name: review_url
tools.description: Review a live public web page by its URL, no code needed.
